description: Compare your saved height and block hash with Diamond's active Bitcoin chain. Returns the observed active hash and checkpoint match status. Paid per call. Price: 6 sats or US$0.006 (USDC) per call.

checkpoint.description: Supply the saved checkpoint as height:expected_block_hash.

l402.description: Optional. After paying the Lightning invoice: '<token>:<preimage>'.

pass.description: Optional. A Diamond budget token (dp_...) that your user approved once (from US$0.89; USDC or other Base tokens, or Lightning) or that you funded with the free diamond_budget tool. Each call deducts its price; no wallet needed in the agent.

pay_with.description: Optional. 'lightning' requests a BOLT11 invoice and a token when Diamond can receive Lightning payments.
